svg.title: Dobot X1 curated TensorBoard reward by training iteration
svg.desc: Five mean-reward curves from runs physically archived under good_runs. Dashed lines are the historical 60D generation and solid lines are the 72D generation.
svg.text: Dobot X1 curated runs: TensorBoard reward vs iteration
Train/mean_reward, 200-iteration trailing mean · source: logs/rsl_rl/good_runs only
Reward definitions changed between 60D (dashed) and 72D (solid); compare within generation.
